Question Choices: What does area tell us about a shape? (A) How tall it is   (B) How much space it covers  (C) How many sides it has
Solution: B   -> Area tells us how much space a shape covers on a surface.

Question Choices: What is a unit square? (A) A square that is 100 unit long and 100 unit wide  (B) A square that is 1 unit long and 1 unit wide
Solution: B   -> A unit square is a square with: width = 1 unit & height = 1 unit. It is used to measure area.

Question Choices: Select. A shape is covered by 10 unit squares. What is its area? : 1-square-units 5-square-units 10-square-units
Solution: 10-square-units   -> Area = number of unit squares covering the shape.

Question Choices: What is a square foot? (A) A square that is 100 foot by 100 foot  (B) A square that is 1 foot by 1 foot
Hints: Think about the size( length and width) of the square
Solution: B  -> A square foot is a unit of area where: length = 1 foot & width = 1 foot

Question Choices: Select. If a rectangle is covered by 13 square feet, what is its area?: 3-square-feet 13-square-feet 10-square-feet
Solution: Area is the number of squares covering the shape. So the rectangle has 13 square feet of area.

Question Choices: Select. How many square feet make 1 square voot?: 6-square-feet 4-square-feet 3-square-feet
Solution: The big voot square contains 4 small square feet. So: 1 square voot = 4 square feet.

Question Choices: If a rectangle is 3 square voots, how many square feet is that?
Solution: 1 voot = 4 square feet. 3 voots × 4 square feet each = 12 square feet

Question Choices: Shape A has 15 square units. Shape B has 23 square units. Which shape covers more space?
Solution: 23 > 15 So Shape B has larger area

Question Choices: If a shape has 2 square voots, how many square feet is that?
Solution: 1 voot = 4 square feet. 2 x 4 = 8. So the are is 8 square feet

Question Choices: The same rectangle can measured as 16 square feet. It can also be measured as 4 square voots. Does this mean one measurement is wrong? Answer yes or no
Hints: The rectangle stayed the same size.
Solution: The rectangle is still the same size. Only the unit used to measure it changed.
